title: Family Members
description: Learn Hindi words for family members — parents, siblings, and grandparents.

exercises.explanation: The core immediate family words in Hindi — 'maa' and 'papa' are the most common everyday terms.

exercises.question: What does 'dada' mean in Hindi?
exercises.explanation: 'Dada' = paternal grandfather (father's father). Hindi has separate words for paternal and maternal grandparents.
'Nani' = maternal grandmother (mother's mother). 'Dadi' = paternal grandmother (father's mother).
Hindi distinguishes paternal (dada/dadi) from maternal (nana/nani) grandparents — unlike English.

exercises.sentence: Meri ___ ka naam Radha hai. (My sister's name is Radha.)
exercises.explanation: 'Meri behen ka naam Radha hai' = my sister's name is Radha. Note 'meri' (feminine possessive) for behen.
'Bhai' means brother. 'Bhai' is also used as a friendly address to any man — like 'bro' or 'mate'.
'Meri maa ka naam Sita hai' = my mother's name is Sita. Ka naam = 's name (possession).

exercises.question: How do you say 'I have one brother' in Hindi?
exercises.explanation: 'Mera ek bhai hai' = I have one brother (literally: my one brother is). Mera = my (masculine).
